description: This PHP source file defines the class 'CaseUpdatesHook' which manages case update operations, email notifications, file attachments, and case status updates within the SuiteCRM platform, extending SugarCRM functionalities.

classes.name: CaseUpdatesHook
classes.description: A class handling case update logic, email notifications, file attachments, and status management in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getAssignToUser
methods.description: Retrieves the next user to assign a case to via AOPAssignManager.

methods.name: arrangeFilesArray
methods.description: Rearranges the $_FILES array for multiple file uploads related to case updates.

methods.name: saveUpdate
methods.description: Saves a case update, handles file attachments, and creates related notes.

methods.name: newNote
methods.description: Creates a new Note bean associated with a case update.

methods.name: linkAccountAndCase
methods.description: Links an account to a case if not already linked.

methods.name: assignAccount
methods.description: Assigns an account to a case based on related contact.

methods.name: saveEmailUpdate
methods.description: Creates a case update from an email, linking contacts and copying notes.

methods.name: updateCaseStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and state of a case based on configuration mappings.

methods.name: unquoteEmail
methods.description: Removes email reply delimiters and HTML entities from email text.

methods.name: closureNotifyPrep
methods.description: Prepares a case for closure notification by setting email flags.

methods.name: closureNotify
methods.description: Sends closure notification email if case is closed.

methods.name: sendClosureEmail
methods.description: Composes and sends an email notification upon case closure.

methods.name: creationNotify
methods.description: Sends notification email when a new case contact relationship is created.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Populates email templates with case and contact data.

methods.name: getAOPConfig
methods.description: Retrieves AOP configuration settings from global $sugar_config.

methods.name: sendCreationEmail
methods.description: Sends an email notification for case creation.

methods.name: logEmail
methods.description: Logs email details into the Emails module.

methods.name: filterHTML
methods.description: Cleans HTML content in case descriptions.

methods.name: sendCaseUpdate
methods.description: Sends email notifications for case updates, respecting configuration and context.
